comment_usage: 🎯 Modify any section; keys under laws.* accept every public spelling of a law (canonical name / printed slug / id / legacyId)
comment_docs: 💡 See README.md and CHANGELOG.md in the RuleOfCode package
comment_laws: ⚖️ paretoMode is an explicit opt-in (true = only the high-impact core). A missing laws.enabled = all laws; enabled is an allowlist — an empty/non-matching allowlist does not pass silently, the audit refuses (exit 1). notApplicable requires a documented reason. failOnWarnings escalates warning → failure.
comment_ignores: 🚫 .ruleofcode-cache/ is the artifact of the RoC audit cache (only when performance.cache: true) — keep it in the repo's .gitignore too
comment_performance: ⚡ cache is opt-in: it caches the compliance result (risk of a stale PASSED) and creates .ruleofcode-cache/ in the root — add it to .gitignore if you enable it
